content: The protein known as FUN14 domain containing 1 (FUNDC1) in humans is encoded by the FUNDC1 gene. Model organisms have been utilized to investigate the function of FUNDC1. A conditional knockout mouse line, named Fundc1tm1a(KOMP)Wtsi, was created as part of the International Knockout Mouse Consortium program. This program is a high-throughput mutagenesis initiative aimed at generating and distributing animal models of disease to researchers worldwide. The mouse line was developed at the Wellcome Trust Sanger Institute. Both male and female mice from this line underwent a standardized phenotypic screening process to assess the effects of the gene deletion. A total of 22 tests were conducted on these mutant mice. However, no significant abnormalities were identified in any of the tests performed.
